mapper.select: SELECT /* BookmarkMapper.selectBookmarkCategoryList - 즐겨찾기 카테고리 목록 조회 */ c.bokmk_ctgy_sn AS bokmkCtgySn, /* 즐겨찾기 카테고리 시퀀스ID */ c.user_id AS userId, /* 사용자 ID */ c.bokmk_ctgy_nm AS bokmkCtgyNm, /* 즐겨찾기 카테고리명 */ c.sort_sn AS sortSn, /* 정렬 순서 */ TO_CHAR(c.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS rgstDttm, /* 등록일시 */ TO_CHAR(c.mdfcn_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updtDttm /* 수정일시 */ FROM cdm_own.sup_bokmk_ctgy c /* 즐겨찾기카테고리관리 */ WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.sort_sn ASC, c.bokmk_ctgy_sn ASC
SELECT /* BookmarkMapper.selectMaxCategorySequence - 즐겨찾기 카테고리 최대 시퀀스 조회 */ COALESCE(MAX(c.bokmk_ctgy_sn), 0) AS maxSequence FROM cdm_own.sup_bokmk_ctgy c /* 즐겨찾기카테고리관리 */ WHERE c.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT /* BookmarkMapper.selectBookmarkList - 즐겨찾기 목록 조회 */ bm.user_id AS userId, /* 사용자 ID */ bc.bokmk_ctgy_sn AS bokmkCtgySn, /* 카테고리 ID */ bc.bokmk_ctgy_nm AS bokmkCtgyNm, /* 카테고리 이름 */ bm.bokmk_menu_id AS bokmkMenuId, /* 즐겨찾기 메뉴 ID */ m.menu_nm AS menuNm, /* 메뉴 이름 */ bc.sort_sn AS ctgySortSn, /* 카테고리 정렬 순번 */ bm.sort_sn AS menuSortSn /* 메뉴 정렬 순번 */ FROM cdm_own.sup_bokmk_menu bm /* 즐겨찾기메뉴관리 */ INNER JOIN cdm_own.sup_bokmk_ctgy bc /* 즐겨찾기카테고리관리 */ ON bm.bokmk_ctgy_sn = bc.bokmk_ctgy_sn AND bm.user_id = bc.user_id INNER JOIN cdm_own.menu m /* 메뉴 */ ON bm.bokmk_menu_id = m.menu_id AND m.npag_yn in('M', 'P', 'Y') INNER JOIN ( select menu.menu_id from cdm_own.menu menu inner join cdm_own.menu_auth menu_authrt on menu.menu_id = menu_authrt.menu_id inner join cdm_own.auth authrt on menu_authrt.auth_cd = authrt.auth_cd inner join cdm_own.usr usr on usr.auth_cd = authrt.auth_cd where usr.usr_id = #{userId} union all select menu.menu_id from cdm_own.menu menu inner join cdm_own.usr_menu_auth menu_authrt on menu.menu_id = menu_authrt.menu_id and menu_authrt.auth_grnt_dvcd = '01' /* 권한이 부여된 */ where menu_authrt.usr_id = #{userId} except select menu.menu_id from cdm_own.menu menu inner join cdm_own.usr_menu_auth menu_authrt on menu.menu_id = menu_authrt.menu_id and menu_authrt.auth_grnt_dvcd = '02' /* 권한이 제거된 */ where menu_authrt.usr_id = #{userId} ) AUTHRT_MENU ON m.menu_id = AUTHRT_MENU.menu_id WHERE bm.user_id = #{userId} AND COALESCE(m.menu_use_yn, 'Y') != 'N' ORDER BY bc.sort_sn ASC, bm.sort_sn ASC, bm.reg_dt ASC
